subject: Every charger at the demo site appears offline
message: All six chargers at synthetic site SITE-DEMO-TOR-07 show Offline since 09:18 UTC. Charger CHG-CA-2001 last reported a heartbeat at 09:16 UTC and three drivers are waiting.

evidence.quote: Every charger at the demo site appears offline
All six chargers at synthetic site SITE-DEMO-TOR-07 show Offline since 09:18 UTC
Charger CHG-CA-2001 last reported a heartbeat at 09:16 UTC and three drivers are waiting.
evidence.meaning: Shows missing heartbeat and drivers waiting.

policies.label: OCPP connectivity
policies.guidance: Verify heartbeat, last-seen timestamp, and network path.

policies.label: Charger site outage
policies.guidance: Identify affected site scope and escalate operational impact.

subject: Two payments taken for one order
message: The checkout page froze, I pressed pay again, and now my bank app shows two payments for the same order 59902.

evidence.quote: Two payments taken for one order
evidence.meaning: duplicate payment due to checkout freeze

evidence.quote: The checkout page froze, I pressed pay again, and now my bank app shows two payments for the same order 59902.
evidence.meaning: user experienced freeze and double payment

policies.label: Double charge
policies.guidance: Check the payment processor first: refund a second capture at once; if it is only a pending authorization, explain that it drops off within 5 days.

subject: Please export and then delete our data
message: We are closing our account at the end of the month. Please export all project data for us, and then delete our workspace and the personal data of our users.

evidence.quote: Please export all project data for us, and then delete our workspace and the personal data of our users.
evidence.meaning: Customer requests export of all project data followed by workspace and personal data deletion.

policies.label: Data deletion
policies.guidance: Confirm the requester owns the account, deliver any requested export first, check for active subscriptions or legal holds, then schedule deletion for the requested date.
